description: This file defines architecture-specific interfaces for an AUTOSAR-based operating system, including context switching, stack management, hardware initialization, and reboot procedures. It serves as an abstraction layer for porting the OS to different hardware architectures.

methods.name: Os_ArchSetSpAndCall
methods.description: Sets the stack pointer to sp and calls function f.

methods.name: Os_ArchSwapContext
methods.description: Swaps the current context, updating the PCB.

methods.name: Os_ArchSwapContextTo
methods.description: Performs context swap for the first time for a task.

methods.name: Os_ArchSetupContext
methods.description: Initializes a PCB before use, setting up context markers, registers, and stack checks.

methods.name: Os_ArchGetStackPtr
methods.description: Returns the current value of the stack pointer.

methods.name: Os_ArchInit
methods.description: Initializes hardware components such as interrupt controller and timers.

methods.name: Os_ArchFirstCall
methods.description: Handles task entry for the first time; may switch to user mode if supported.

methods.name: Os_ArchReboot
methods.description: Reboots the OS, either warm or cold, for system reset and recovery.

methods.name: Os_ArchGetScSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the small context in bytes.

methods.name: Os_ArchPanic
methods.description: Handles panic situations with error code and frame pointers.
